_source: Physical conditions are reporter-confirmed observations. The release gate applies to PPE suggestions. Optional condition inference covers floor liquid and walkway obstructions.

categories.name: Worker without hard hat
categories.why: Falling objects and head strikes on pipework and structures.

categories.name: Worker without eye / face protection
categories.why: Caustic splash to the eyes can cause permanent loss of sight.

categories.name: Worker without gloves
categories.why: Caustic burns, hot surfaces and sharp edges.

categories.name: Worker without high-visibility vest
categories.why: Struck by mobile plant or vehicles in traffic areas.

categories.name: Possible liquid on the floor
categories.why: Slips and falls; a spill can also be hot or caustic in a refinery. The AI never says what the liquid is.

categories.name: Object possibly obstructing a walkway
categories.why: Trips and blocked escape routes. Counts only when a walkway is visible in the photo.

categories.name: Uncovered floor opening or missing grating
